correctness.rationale: Four simple rational poles and noncoboundary guarantee smooth geometrically integral genus six. For n coprime to three, translation x to x+1 proves all zero Frobenius power sums. Exhaustive direct fibre enumeration over 3^3 and 3^6 establishes N3=76 and N6=670; cross-checks use independently computed absolute traces and rigorous modulus irreducibility. Newton identities and Hasse–Weil reciprocity determine all twelve coefficients. Exact factor multiplication and integral-factor exclusion establish an elliptic square times a simple abelian-surface square, and P(1)=1296. No finite experiment is used as proof of infinitely many extensions without the functional equation.

value.rationale: The exact curve is the nonclassical ordinary genus-six equality case with automorphism group order 72 in the recent classification, not an unmotivated choice. Its complete Frobenius spectrum, exceptional degree-divisible-by-three point behavior, two repeated rational Weil factors, and exact Jacobian order refine the geometric classification by natural arithmetic invariants. Neither group classification nor general algorithm alone supplies these values.
